{{Otheruses|Capital}}
{{MoreSources}}
[[File:SenateDistrict-POP.png|thumb|260px|Galactic City on Coruscant, the galactic capital]]
The '''capital''' of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or territory was usually the primary [[City/Legends|city]] and was the seat of that planet or territory's government. However, a capital would not always be the largest city of that area. Similarly, a capital world was the primary planet in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and to an extension, the whole [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Often a capital planet of a sector was simply the oldest (and most known or advanced) inhabited planet. It was common custom in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to name Sectors and Systems after their capital planet. For example, [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was located within the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], itself a part of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].

==History==
===Galactic capitals===
In ancient times, the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] homeworld of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] served as the capital of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] until its collapse.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served as the capital of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for over twenty-five millennia.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> It also served as the capital for several galactic governments including the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]],<ref name="Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Legacy Broken 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> and the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]].<ref name="Legacy Broken 1" /> During the seventeen [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] ([[17,000 BBY]]&ndash;[[3017 BBY]]), Alsakan contested Coruscant's right to be the galactic capital.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] designated [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] as the capital of his [[Dark Empire]].<ref name="Dark Empire">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref> The [[Pentastar Alignment]], one of the remnants of the Empire, had its capital on the planet [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Following the destruction of Byss, the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] under [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] was based on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]]<ref name="Empire Lost 2">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 2]]</ref> before finally settling down on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Bastion would later serve as the capital of the [[Fel Empire]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]<ref name="Legacy Broken 1" /> and the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy Broken 3">[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]]</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the extra-galactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|seized]] the galactic capital Coruscant in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> The Vong terraformed Coruscant as [[Coruscant/Legends#Yuuzhan'tar|Yuuzhan'tar]] in an attempt to remake it in the image of their [[Yuuzhan'tar|lost homeworld]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Coruscant was [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|retaken]] by Galactic Alliance and allied forces in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. Following the death of [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]] and the capitulation of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]], the Vong relocated to the living world of [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]], which was an offshoot of the original Yuuzhan'tar. While Coruscant was being rebuilt, the Galactic Alliance established a temporary capital on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] world of [[Denon/Legends|Denon]].<ref name="The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

===Other governments===
[[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] served as the capital of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]] until the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Evil Never Dies">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> Later, Darth [[Tenebrae|Vitiate's]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|True Sith Empire]] based its capital on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas']] [[Kaas City]].<ref name="Old Republic Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> During the [[Light and Darkness War]], [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] served as the capital of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> During the [[Republic Dark Age]], [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] served as the capital of the Sith fiefdom known as the [[Daimanate]] while a rival Sith fiefdom called the [[Arkadianate]] was based on [[Calimondretta]].<ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] novel</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established its capital on [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]]<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].<ref name="EGW" /> [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] served as the capital of the [[Trade Federation]] during the last decades of the Old Republic.<ref name="Darth Maul Saboteur">"[[Darth Maul: Saboteur]]"</ref> [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] served as the headquarters of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].<ref name="CW Chapter 2">{{CW|2}}</ref> During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] served as the capital of the secessionist [[Confederation]].<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

In ancient times, the planet [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] was the capital of the ancient [[Hutt Empire]] until the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] relocated to the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Evocar]] in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and renamed it [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="TEA" /> In the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], [[Argai]] served as the capital of the [[Kingdom of Cron]] and later [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> Centuries later, the planet [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] served as the capital of the [[Livien League]] and later the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Tionese War]], Desevro was devastated by the Republic.<ref name="EGW" />

The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], the government of a corporate fiefdom known as the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], based its capital on the planet [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]].<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Authority Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> The city of [[Ta'a Chume]] on the planet [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] served as the administrative capital of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], an insular matriarchal regime in the Inner Rim.<ref name="Cracken's Threat Dossier">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> The icy planet of [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]] served as the capital of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Force Heretic: Refugee">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref> [[Lwhekk/Legends|Lwhekk]] was the capital of the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]], another political power in the Unknown Regions' [[Ssi-ruuk Star Cluster]].<ref name="Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

Several planetary governments also had a capital [[city]]. [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] was the capital of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] was the capital of the Outer Rim world of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="Truce at Bakura" /> [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] was the capital of the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Cracken's Threat Dossier" /> [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] was the capital of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] served as the capital of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> while [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] was the capital of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="db">{{DB|location|kashyyyk|Kashyyyk}}</ref>
